findings.description: Plan omitted the codexu submodule workflow and used wrong absolute marketplace-index paths (D:/ai-developer-toolkit/...). Target files live inside the ai-developer-toolkit submodule; edits need the two-commit flow (submodule commit + codexu pointer-bump) and the marketplace indexes are at the toolkit root.
findings.resolution: Added 'Repo & Submodule Workflow' subsection; corrected all marketplace paths to repo-relative ai-developer-toolkit/{.claude-plugin,.github/plugin,.agents/plugins}/marketplace.json; prefixed all file paths with ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/ralph-overview/.

findings.description: AC10 missed the codexu repo-root AGENTS.md 'Active Plugin Versions' table bump (2.9.0 -> 2.10.0), which is a CI invariant and must change in the same codexu commit as the submodule pointer bump.
findings.resolution: AC10, scope, US-004, and Repo & Submodule Workflow now require the root codexu AGENTS.md Active Plugin Versions table bump in the pointer-bump commit.

findings.description: scripts/lib/task-aliases.mjs has no .d.mts declaration, so importing resolveTaskLifecycle from the TypeScript MCP package would fail npm run typecheck (verified: sibling helpers have .d.mts, task-aliases does not).
findings.resolution: D-C primary path now reads the already-normalized task.lifecycle directly (no import); adding scripts/lib/task-aliases.d.mts is documented as a conditional only-if-imported step.

findings.description: snapshotAgeMs typed as number contradicts AC6 requiring snapshotAgeMs === null on missing snapshot. Type must be number | null.
findings.resolution: D-G, D-G result type, scope, US-003 now specify snapshotAgeMs?: number | null.

findings.description: Unified prereq model mentioned only blockedOn, but OverviewTask also supports reverse 'blocks'; a data.json-only blocks relationship would be ignored under a stale/missing snapshot, letting a blocked task surface as ready.
findings.resolution: D-E rewritten to re-derive a FRESH dependency graph via deriveDependencyGraph({byTaskId, overviewData, prdsByTaskId}), which handles blockedOn + reverse blocks + PRD depends-on-story + spawn from authoritative data. Added a missing-snapshot blocks test expectation (AC5/AC6).

findings.description: Manual blockedOn-union-with-snapshot-graph is more error-prone than reusing derive-dependency-graph.mjs (which already handles blockedOn, blocks, PRD deps, spawn and has a .d.mts).
findings.resolution: Adopted derive-dependency-graph reuse as the primary approach in D-E; manual union explicitly rejected.

findings.description: US-001 claimed graceful missing-snapshot (AC6) but the readiness model needed for missing-snapshot correctness was deferred to US-002.
findings.resolution: Moved AC6 + the dependency-graph readiness work into US-002; US-001 now owns lifecycle gate + merge + mtime-guard (AC1, AC8).

findings.description: AC8 verification path was ambiguous; the mtime-guard on getOverviewData is shared by expand-task-context and must be covered at the SnapshotReader level, not only via the tool (which currently hard-fails before reading data.json).
findings.resolution: AC8 now requires a direct snapshot-reader.test.ts test of the mtime-guarded getOverviewData.

findings.description: AC9 'parses data.json at most once per call' lacked a concrete verification mechanism (no parse-count instrumentation exists).
findings.resolution: AC9 now specifies a concrete instrumentation seam (spy/mock around loadOverviewData asserting call-count <= 1, or a test-only parse counter), with the timer as informational only.

findings.description: snapshotStaleReason shape left too loose for an autonomous implementer; should specify minimum content distinguishing 'data.json newer' from 'snapshot missing' and include age.
findings.resolution: D-G + AC3 + AC6 now require the reason to include the age and a stable marker distinguishing the two cases.

findings.description: Plan mtime-guards getOverviewData but not getSnapshot; should state whether snapshot freshness stays watcher-dependent.
findings.resolution: Added D-I documenting the freshness boundary: only getOverviewData is mtime-guarded; snapshot freshness stays watcher-dependent (D-002 boundary) and any staleness is surfaced, not masked.

findings.description: Adding ReadyTask.enrichment / result fields without confirming no exact-key tests or docs snapshots pin the result shape.
findings.resolution: Risk Areas now requires confirming no consumer asserts an exact ReadyTask key set and no docs/snapshot fixture pins the result shape.

findings.description: Round 2: deriveDependencyGraph expects byTaskId: OverviewRalphState['byTaskId'] (Record<string, RalphPipelineState>) and reads byTaskId[taskId]?.stage; the plan said to pass 'the snapshot tasks-by-id map'. A Map<string, SnapshotTask> would fail typecheck and lose stage enrichment (stage lives under .ralph.stage). Verified at derive-dependency-graph.mjs:20,56-70 and .d.mts:5.
findings.resolution: D-E + US-002 now specify byTaskId = Record<taskId, RalphPipelineState> built via Object.fromEntries(snapshot.tasks.flatMap(t => t.ralph ? [[t.id, t.ralph]] : [])), keeping the merged Map<string, SnapshotTask> separate for readiness/title lookups.

findings.description: Round 2: US-004 hand-edits plugin.json + marketplace indexes + CHANGELOG, but toolkit AGENTS.md mandates using /release-plugin for plugin version bumps. Repo-rule divergence.
findings.resolution: US-004, AC10, and Repo & Submodule Workflow now require /release-plugin (or mirroring its outputs) for the version surfaces + CHANGELOG + codex policy validation.

findings.description: Round 2: workflow said 'commit (and push)' inside the submodule, but codexu AGENTS.md requires asking before any git push; an autonomous implementer could push to shared branches / cut a release without approval.
findings.resolution: Workflow + US-004 + AC10 now require LOCAL commits only; the lead owns FF-merge + multi-remote release push, and the impl asks before any push (ask-before-push rule).
